IbrahimOS

Upload field evidence. IbrahimOS diagnoses the threat, builds the response plan, and tracks recovery.

Built for commercial farm managers on African farms. The live case is North Block 04 in Kaduna: 86 hectares of maize, fall armyworm across three zones, 18.4 hectares at risk, a ₦428,000 response, and a six-hour action window.
